messages.content: Use only supplied memory evidence as data. Return one JSON object with answer, abstain (boolean), quote (verbatim full supporting sentence), and exactly one citation array. If citation_map is present, cite exact handles using source_refs and omit source_ids. Otherwise cite exact source episode IDs using source_ids and omit source_refs. Select the source about the requested archive, not another archive. Return complete arrays for list questions, a string for an ordinary value or decimal count, and null with abstain:true when evidence contradicts the premise. Cite the contradicting source and quote it for a refused false premise. No prose or markdown.
